papers.title: The Economic Impact of Periprosthetic Infections After Total Hip Arthroplasty at a Specialized Tertiary-Care Center
papers.first_author_affiliation: Rubin Institute for Advanced Orthopedics, Center for Joint Preservation and Replacement, Sinai Hospital of Baltimore, Baltimore, Maryland

corresponding_authors.name: Michael A. Mont
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Rubin Institute for Advanced Orthopedics, Center for Joint Preservation and Replacement, Sinai Hospital of Baltimore, Baltimore, Maryland

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅讨论全髋关节置换术后假体周围感染的卫生经济学影响，不涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物设计评估。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it is a clinical economic analysis with no FE modeling or biomechanical evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估全髋关节置换术假体周围感染的经济负担
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析144例感染病例的住院费用和报销数据
summary_zh.result: 感染治疗平均费用显著高于无感染病例，且报销率低
summary_zh.validation: 单中心回顾性数据分析，无外部验证

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the economic burden and reimbursement deficits of periprosthetic joint infections following primary total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective chart review of 144 infection cases at a specialized tertiary-care center, analyzing direct hospital costs and reimbursement.
summary_en.result: Treatment of periprosthetic infection incurred substantially higher costs than uninfected primary arthroplasty, with low reimbursement rates.
summary_en.validation: Single-center retrospective analysis without external validation or biomechanical experiments.

papers.title: Early Outcomes of Revision Surgery for Taper Corrosion of Dual Taper Total Hip Arthroplasty in 187 Patients
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Harvard Medical School, Massachusetts General Hospital, Boston, Massachusetts

corresponding_authors.name: Young‐Min Kwon
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Harvard Medical School, Massachusetts General Hospital, Boston, Massachusetts

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究双锥度全髋关节置换术的翻修手术结果，未涉及生物力学建模或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not report any biomechanical metrics (stress, strain, micromotion) or computational modeling; it is a clinical outcomes study only.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析双锥度全髋关节置换术中锥部腐蚀的翻修手术早期结果
summary_zh.method: 回顾187例患者翻修手术数据
summary_zh.result: 翻修后早期效果良好但需进一步随访

summary_en.motivation: This study evaluates early outcomes of revision surgery for taper corrosion in dual taper total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective review of 187 patients who underwent revision surgery for taper corrosion.
summary_en.result: Early outcomes were favorable, but longer follow-up is needed.
summary_en.validation: Retrospective clinical study without computational validation.

key_terms.zh: 双锥度全髋关节置换术

papers.title: Does Hip Arthroscopy Affect the Outcomes of a Subsequent Total Hip Arthroplasty?
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Rush University, Chicago, Illinois

corresponding_authors.name: Bryan D. Haughom
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Rush University, Chicago, Illinois

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文纯临床研究，不涉及髋关节假体的生物力学建模或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanical modeling, no finite element analysis, no quantification of stress shielding or micromotion, and no implant design or comparison.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估髋关节镜术后全髋关节置换的疗效是否受影响
summary_zh.method: 回顾性队列研究，比较有和无髋关节镜史患者的THA结果
summary_zh.result: 髋关节镜史对THA术后并发症和再手术率无显著影响
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床患者数据，采用统计比较

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether prior hip arthroscopy influences the outcomes of subsequent total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective cohort study comparing complication and revision rates between patients with and without prior hip arthroscopy.
summary_en.result: No significant differences in postoperative outcomes or reoperation rates were observed between the two groups.
summary_en.validation: Clinical data from patient records were analyzed using statistical methods.
